note: Found by searching, anonymously and read-only, by meta-macbook-20261120-4 for tasks/034 (req-hoomd-oldroyd-b-001, req-rheotool-oldroyd-b-001). Read as a cross-check of the Waters and King series. Critique: its text writes the series with a growing exponential exp(alpha_n T/2) and G = sinh + (gamma_n/beta_n) cosh, while its code computes exp(-alpha_n T/2) times (cosh + (gamma/beta) sinh) with complex beta, and its plot compares the code with its simulation; with n = (2k-1) pi, alpha_n = 2 b_k and beta_n = 2 c_k the code is the form of mat-20261121-amoreira-oliveira-2010-startup, and the text is not. Refinement: not a source for the relation; it shows that the series is easily miswritten, so the library skill's worked case must be checked against the paper's own figure.
